title: Goonga mo Muumɗini Ñaawirde ndee
intro: E nder galle laamorɗo ɗo yeddude laamii, laamu nguu ina timmi, dental gollotooɓe e karallaagal ina darii e yeeso caɗeele ɗe cikkaaka. Henndu nduu ina 6uu6too e 6uu6ol nde laabi cficfi fenaande e goonga ina njogori 6uu6nude. Mooftuɓe ɓee nganndaano wonde ndeeɗoo hawriinde ina wayla nguurndam maɓɓe haa abada, ina ƴetta daartol maɓɓe e nder binndol ceningol ngol.
clues: Min nganndiraama karallaagal amen e illusions, min kawri ko e laamɗo doole ngam haɓaade luulndiiɗo.
Nde waktu oo yonti, min mberli kuutorɗe amen, min padi ko yaltata, min ngoongɗini karallaagal amen.
Kono ko min ceedtii koo, waɗii kaɓirɗe amen ko nanndi e pijirlooji tan, ɓerɗe amen ina nganndi goonga mo yeddaaka.
Min njippii e leydi e sujjude, min mbiya min ngoongɗini Joomiraawo Muusaa e Haaruuna, hay so tawii laamɗo oo ina mettini heen.
Ndeen laamɗo hulɓinii en e jukkungo ɓurngo bonde, o huniima en e leggal bardugal, taƴde terɗe men laabi luurondirɗi.
En keddii e darnde, en mbiyi en ɓuri yiɗde ñaawoore Joomiraawo men e kala batte aduna, en martiri ngam goonɗinal men.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
